mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.path, i.author_id, i.created_at FROM images i INNER JOIN image_quote iq ON i.id = iq.image_id WHERE iq.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
SELECT i.id, i.title, i.path, i.author_id, i.created_at FROM images i WHERE i.author_id = #{authorId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM image_quote iq WHERE iq.image_id = i.id) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO images (id, title, path, author_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{path}, #{authorId}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO image_quote (article_id, image_id) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{imageId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM image_quote WHERE article_id = #{articleId} AND image_id = #{imageId}
